study type: Cross-sectional study with predictive model development and validation
exposure: average time spent in child-parent interactions
cohort: The study included 9,581 children under the age of three, selected using stratified random sampling in Shenzhen, China.
finding: Key predictors of stunting, including sex, age, mother's education, father's age, birth order, feeding patterns, delivery mode, parent-child reading time, child-parent interactions, and outdoor time, were identified and used to develop a comprehensive prediction model with excellent consistency and accuracy.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as a key predictor of stunting among children under three years of age.
cross-section timing: Children were assessed when they were under the age of three years.
